text:
sara: FYI seeing a subtle but persistent P99 tail increase on eu-west GPU hosts since ~03:10 UTC, correlates with a handful of tenants. :thinking:
kai: which hosts? can you paste the host ids?
sara: host-az3-012, host-az3-014, host-az3-015. Kernel NIC queues look okay but GPU mem series shows repeated small drops (kvcache churn?)
ben: timeline? any batch jobs started around that time?
sara: spikes every ~4-6m, short bursts that nudge latency. no big batch cron in logs. tenant list: vigil-prod, alpha-experiments, guest-scratch. vigil has sustained high prefix reuse.
ops-bot: alert: GPU temp delta > 6C on host-az3-014 at 03:14 UTC (auto-ack false)
leila: could be a small tenant working set overflowing slab -> causing tiny OOMs -> eviction thrash. we saw similar with micro-embeddings last quarter.
kai: suggestion: soft-quarantine the top offender tenant (vigil-prod) to a nearby reserve pool for 30m while we probe. that buys us space without full eviction. @sara you good running a soft-quarantine?
sara: yep. plan: 1) tag vigil-prod with reprioritize:soft-quarantine 2) route new allocs to dedicated-warm-az3 for 30m 3) enable verbose kvcache telemetry.
ben: add a temporary egress cap to the tenant (5Gbps) while quarantined, avoid network-heavy bursts.
leila: also enable per-slab debug on the three hosts, capture two cycles (4m). small overhead but worth it.
sara: running commands now:
```
# soft quarantine tag
./ctl tenant update --id vigilant --set labels.reprioritize=soft-quarantine --duration 30m
# backfill route to dedicated-warm-az3
./alloc plan --tenant vigilant --preferred-pool dedicated-warm-az3 --priority low
```
kai: thanks. keep watch on P99 and KV cache hit ratio. if no improvement in 15m we escalate to preemptive carveout (move to reserved slice).
sara: initial telemetry: kvcache hit ratio dropped from 94% -> 78% during bursts, memory pressure up ~200MB transient. after quarantine route started (03:19) first 10m show 30% fewer spikes :thumbsup:
ben: good signal. keep the egress cap for the 30m window. will prepare a quick cost estimate if we need longer reserve (dedicated-warm is ~0.18 GPU-hr extra).
leila: logging note: add a short tag to the trace to mark the quarantine window so we can slice evals later.
ops-bot: event: tenant vigil-prod soft-quarantine applied by sara at 03:19 UTC
sara: will monitor for the next 20m and report back. if spikes persist we do the reserved carveout + migrate alpha-experiments off the hosts too.
kai: 👍 also filing a short runbook blurb so oncall can replicate quickly.
sara: update @channel 03:36 UTC — quarantine complete 30m window ended; post-window metrics stable, P99 returned to baseline, will keep short term watch and reopen if drift returns. :white_check_mark:
